name: What is the difference between water damage and mold remediation?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between water damage and mold remediation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Water damage restoration focuses on drying out affected areas, repairing structural components, and restoring properties after water intrusion. Mold remediation, however, specifically addresses and removes mold growth that results from prolonged moisture exposure. While often related, mold remediation requires specialized techniques and equipment to safely contain and remove fungal contaminants.
acceptedAnswer.description: Water damage restoration dries and repairs properties after leaks, while mold remediation specifically removes mold growth caused by prolonged moisture. They are often performed together.
